notes.title: RocketJump Cascade v0.6.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Thanks for trying out RJC update v0.6.2! After releasing it you all informed me of many terrible mistakes I made in the matrix that is the games code. In exchange here is a patch to solve a few problems as well as update a few maps
Maps
LavaTower - NEW MAP

 This map was previously an extra path in LavaTemple and has been moved to its own level
 The platforming has all been changed to make it more interesting
 This level utilizes Jump pads

LavaTemple

 The Tower path has been split off into a new rift known as LavaTower
 The previous left path has been consolidated with the Tomb path
 Tomb path has been extended to be more challenging
 Added a breakable wall to tomb path
 Middle path has been updated to have more interesting platforming
 Added some walls you can shoot with your rockets

Underground

 Blocked off the side path as it was not really worth going to
 Improved the ground material quality

Outlands

 Updated skybox
 Updated lighting to be less flat
 Changed design of the land

SewerTown

 Replaced placeholder houses with more fitting ones
 Updated pathing slightly and repositioned dash pickups

Necropolis

 Improved quality ground material (cause im stupid)

Upward

 Changed textures of objects in area

HubMap

 Updated SPAAAACEEEE skybox
 The Hub ship has been redesigned with a new layout


Changes

 Added a Extras tab to the settings menu
 Added FOV Slider to Extras menu
 Added hide viewmodel to Extras menu (for die hard TF2 players)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580633/4472a71c03bf17fca690a25b63af52c81ed0dffb.png
 Changed input menu to automatically switch to the controller/mouse and keyboard screen depending on which input you are using (was confusing to see MnK settings while you are using controller)
 Refactored how mouse sensitvity is calculated - allow entering a custom sens value

📝The way sens was calculated leaded to even the slowest sens being alot faster than expected so it has been tweaked and the slider now scales much lower and higher

 Overhauled the look of Boost Ramps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580633/ce61c9e8ec63948df4f3bf6d1cdf099dd9fe9036.png
 Lighting pass has been made on all areas to help improve the look(let me know what you think)
 Added a return to hub button on the deathscreen
 Tweaked the highlighting when hovering menu buttons
 Added a Tiers to each map in the level select 

📝Tiers are intended to be a way to gauge the difficulty of the level you are entering- levels that are far too easy or difficult are planned to be reworked to match that tier. - similar to surf and bhop games

Fixes

 Fixed the saved sensitivity not being utilized(it was always 1.0 sens)
 Fixed the sensitivity slider not automatically updating its value in the menu
 Fixed sens slider not properly applying to controllers
 Fixed runtime error when launching from a Nokia 3310
 Fixed bug with boost ramps not always launching you the expected way
 Fixed Pause defaulting to the Share button instead of Start
 Fixed Crouch defaulting to alt instead of ctrl
 Fixed audio starting loud on level load

notes.title: RocketJumpCascade v0.6.2 THE CONTROLLER UPDATE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mpmNYcsZ0Zw;full][/previewyoutube]

Controller support
You can now play the game using a controller as well as a brand new menu has been introduced to allow you rebind any keys you desire to change. You may also switch between keyboard and controller at any time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580633/062b66669b40e212b0004f1774d88b1bfcdf0b8c.png


RocketLauncher Skins
Every level now includes a skin you can discover and you can now collect all of them and cycle between them for whichever one is your favorite. These skins are completely free and can all be found by finding them in their respective levels!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580633/471e21a098c450883a0a7201af6096729d5fc9c8.gif

Menu Overhaul
All the menus have been upgraded to have a more unified theme and tweaked configuration such as picking any resolution you would like now. Let me know what you think
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580633/1681eb764c91f433f7c6f5e4e5cacd4cd90804a1.png

Save System Overhaul
While not the most glamorous the entire backend of the save system has been overhauled to better track your speedrun pbs, levels you  have completed, skins you have acquired, and even more. Idk how to make this interesting to read but i am putting it anyways.

These are just the headlines but an exhaustive list of changes can be found below:
RJC v0.6.2 Full Patch Notes
Changes and Improvements
- Overhauled menu design
- Added resolution selector
- Controller support added
- Pause menus overhauled with new button designs
- Your character has some nice gloves now
- Added level select terminal in the HubWorld
- Redesigned level select screen
- The hub terminal will now display how many rifts you completed and deaths
- Updated default renderer to help with performance
- Reduced memory footprint of some assets in the game
- Updated resolution used by textures to help with performance
- Improvements to mouse input to better imitate "raw input"
- Settings menu now allows you to rebind controller inputs
- Rocket Launcher skins can now all be collected and saved properly
- New notification when you have picked up a new rocket launcher skin
- Cleaned up files to help reduce the final size of the game (Under 3gb now baby!)
- Save system has been completely overhauled - should avoid missing changes you make or progress made in game
- The game now utilizes DX12 by default but will fallback to DX11or Vulkan when necessary
Bugfixes
- Fixed timer not stopping in SewerTown area
- Fixed issue with visuals in Ripple area
- Fixed bug that prevented auto jumping after a rocket jump
- Fixed issue where game would cause a fire when running the game on a 1997 Honda Civic
- Fixed bug with speedrun save not initializing resulting in 1:00
- Fixed bug with switching RL skins after collecting a new one

Please don't hesitate to post any bugs or feedback in the RJC discord server HERE

notes.title: RocketJump Cascade v0.6 Update - The Speedrun Patch
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-S630_rH-GU;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey RocketJumpers!
I am thrilled to announce the latest update for RocketJump, and it's a game-changer! With a slew of new features, improvements, and tweaks, we're taking your rocket-jumping experience to the next level.

New Rifts Await
Prepare to embark on an adventure like never before as we introduce a whopping 16 new rifts to explore. Each rift offers unique challenges, breathtaking landscapes, and adrenaline-pumping action that will keep you hooked for hours on end.

Speedrun Mode Unleashed
For the competitive spirits among us, we've added a brand new speedrun timer. Race against the clock as you navigate through each level, striving to set new records and claim the title of the ultimate RocketJump champion.

Hub Portals Revamped
Navigating the hub just got a whole lot easier! We've reworked the hub portals to lead you directly to specific worlds, streamlining your journey through the RocketJump universe.
Make sure to explore each rift to the fullest to discover even more areas to traverse along the way.

Level Select Menu and More
We've added a level select menu option, allowing you to jump straight into your favorite rifts with ease. 
Trying to improve your IL times with that insane 1 frame rocket has never been easier to attempt.

 Level Layout Overhauls 
If you played the demos, many areas have been overhauled to include more paths with even more areas to uncover for exploring. Make sure to explore each rift to the fullest for you might find many new maps along the way

 Rocket Launcher Skins 
Many rifts include hidden rocket launcher skins you can find along your journey. You can press B to change the equipped skin.


Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback so far and supported the project. While there is still plenty more work to be put in, this version is a huge milestone for the way RJC plays and i look forward to even more feedback as everyone tries it out

If you would like to join the RocketJump community or provide any feedback you can always stop by the Discord: https://discord.gg/qJBeZTdvWW

Much love from Jamacanbacn <3

notes.title: RocketJumpCascade v0.5 🚀🦘HUGE UPDATE 💥🤯NEW LEVELS 🗺
notes.content:
Movement updates
- Changed the movement and air control to give a slightly more weighted feel
	- These changes are notably closer to CSGO bhop feel than before
- Refined the feeling of stopping yourself in the air
- Added a dash ability pickup in some areas (green aura)
- Added a jump pad in some areas (blue aura)
Rocket Launcher
- You can now right click to fire 2 rockets at one time (consumes 2 ammo)
- Tweaked the firing timings single fire or multishot
- Auto reloads if you reach 0 ammo in magazine
- Press B to change your RL skin (if you have found one!)

Levels
Many areas have been remade and expanded to allow for more to explore and more paths to jump through
- LavaTemple - remastered...
- SewerTown - The town has expanded since the last visit 
- Underground - a new path has opened and secrets await

- The Infinite Forest Rift Runner has been opened. Explore up to 4 new areas by warping through this newly powered rift.

? More areas to discover soon™
Hud Improvements
- Arrow Indicator displays if you have a dash ability stored
- Now include info about the Rift you are about to enter 
- Updated the hud to display health in Hearts
- Changed the layout of info
- The pause screen now displays the current build you are playing on
- The pause screen now displays current level name (no idk why i named that level that )

Engine Upgrade

- Major update from UE 5.0.3 -> 5.2

Bugs
- Fixed bugs causing the rocket to not explode
- Fixed many bugs causing the rocket to clip through walls/floors
- Fixed cases where you would get stuck on the rocket in mid air
- Fixed fullscreen button not working properly
- Fixed Music tracks playing in full volume after changing the volume
- Fixed a few bugs when entering portals in the Hub
- Fixed some input bugs with the dash ability
-  Levels now stream based on what you are viewing to hopefully help with loading problems
-  Fixed postprocess effect in some maps
- Fixed some sounds not using the proper volume slider
- Fixed bugs with the speed display
- Fixed numerous bugs with save data - please report  if anything is not saving

---------------------------------

notes.title: v0.4 Progress Report
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u8ooTJaoY9A&feature=youtu.be


In the video I detail the challenges and plans moving forward with the game.
v0.4 is cooking in the lab and some of the highlight features from it are:

 Save System
 Revamped Rocket Launcher that looks and feels a lot more polished
 More open level design with more mechanics to play around
 Music tracks for all areas


Once this version of the game is completed I will be releasing the project into Early Access for  $5.
Don't fret I will also continue to keep the Demo up to date with the EA version of the game. If for whatever reason you cannot pay or don't know if the game is for you - try the demo out first and even play the entire game and then decide if you want to give me your money.

Thanks everyone for 8,500 downloads on the demo and I look forward to shipping the next version of the game in a month or two!

notes.title: Thanks for trying out the demo!
notes.content:
I released v0.03 of the game to try as a free demo this month.
Thanks to all the players who have tried it out and added to wishlist.
There has been a lot of great feedback and helpful testing. 

I am hard at work on v0.04 which will include many updates such as 
- More areas to visit in the rift
- A brand new Minigame rift
- Overhaul of UI and settings
- Adding Savepoints to areas
- Improvements to movement speed
- Reworked Reload system
- New Dash ability (pickup)
- Performance improvements 
- Controller support
- Bug fixes 
- Some brand new music tracks 

These updates may be split into more than 1 update but I will know better as I get closer to update day.
If you have any thoughts on what I should prioritize feel free to let me know in the comments!

If you would like to follow the development elsewhere you can join the RJC discord at https://discord.gg/qJBeZTdvWW
Don't forget to wishlist the game on the right side of the screen!
